description: Probability of Exceeding a Precipitation Threshold is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA National Weather Service, Weather Prediction Center. Check the probability that cumulative rainfall will exceed user-defined thresholds within the next three days over 6- to 24-hour intervals. This forecast can serve as an early alert for potential flooding related to heavy precipitation. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – General, Flooding – Rainfall-induced, Water Quality. Assets: Water Infrastructure – General, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
